# runr_rightsizing (Data Source)

A project's rightsizing recommendation ([rightsizing](https://runr.sh/docs/monitoring/#rightsizing)): every night RunR compares what the project's pods used at most in the last 14 days with its size and recommends a smaller one — or a larger one after OOM kills, CPU throttling or memory close to its limit. Without a recommendation, `status` says why (`collecting`, `right_sized`, `not_eligible`).

Applying or dismissing a recommendation stays an action (`runr projects rightsizing apply|dismiss`); with Terraform, feed the size into the project explicitly, e.g. `resources = { cpu = data.runr_rightsizing.x.recommended.cpu, memory_mb = data.runr_rightsizing.x.recommended.memory_mb }` — then the configuration, not RunR, owns the size. Needs `metrics.view` on the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The project exists already: its id comes from a lookup by name (runr_project.api.id would
# make a cycle with the size below).
data "runr_project" "existing" {
  name = "orders-api"
}

data "runr_rightsizing" "api" {
  project_id = data.runr_project.existing.id
}

# Take the recommended size explicitly once there is one: the configuration owns the size.
resource "runr_project" "api" {
  name      = "orders-api"
  type      = "faas"
  runtime   = "python"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
  resources = data.runr_rightsizing.api.recommended == null ? null : {
    cpu       = data.runr_rightsizing.api.recommended.cpu
    memory_mb = data.runr_rightsizing.api.recommended.memory_mb
  }
}

output "rightsizing" {
  value = data.runr_rightsizing.api.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.

### Read-Only

- `blocked` (Attributes) Why applying would be refused now (region capacity, a fixed allocation). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blocked))
- `collecting` (Attributes) How much data the project has toward its first recommendation (`collecting`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collecting))
- `computed_at` (String) When the recommendation was made.
- `current` (Attributes) The project's size now; null without a recommendation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current))
- `direction` (String) `down`, `up` or `mixed`; null without a recommendation.
- `evidence` (Attributes) What the recommendation is based on (one pod's readings). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evidence))
- `pending_deploy` (Boolean) An applied size the running deployment does not have yet.
- `reason` (String) Why a project is `not_eligible`: `gpu`, `stopped`, `not_running`, `unsupported`, `no_metrics` or `disabled`.
- `reasons` (List of String) Why, in words.
- `recommended` (Attributes) The recommended size; null without a recommendation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recommended))
- `savings` (Attributes) The monthly difference the Billing module estimates (positive: saved); null without billing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--savings))
- `status` (String) `open`, `snoozed`, `dismissed` or `applied` (a recommendation), or `collecting` (not enough data yet), `right_sized` or `not_eligible`.

### Nested Schema for `blocked`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Refusal code.
- `message` (String) Message.


<a id="nestedatt--collecting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collecting`

Read-Only:

- `days` (Number) Days with data.
- `required_days` (Number) Days needed.
- `required_sessions` (Number) Sessions needed.
- `sessions` (Number) Sessions with data.
- `window_days` (Number) Days looked at.


<a id="nestedatt--current"></a>
### Nested Schema for `current`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) CPU as a Kubernetes quantity (`250m`), as `runr_project.resources.cpu` takes it.
- `cpu_m` (Number) CPU in millicores.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MiB (`runr_project.resources.memory_mb`).


<a id="nestedatt--evidence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evidence`

Read-Only:

- `always_on` (Boolean) The workload never scales to zero.
- `cpu_max_m` (Number) Highest CPU (millicores).
- `cpu_p95_m` (Number) 95th percentile of CPU (millicores).
- `days` (Number) Days with data.
- `memory_max_mb` (Number) Highest memory working set (MiB).
- `memory_near_limit` (Boolean) Memory came close to its limit.
- `memory_p95_mb` (Number) 95th percentile of memory (MiB).
- `oom_kills` (Number) OOM kills.
- `sessions` (Number) Sessions with data.
- `throttled_ratio` (Number) Share of throttled CPU periods.
- `window_days` (Number) Days looked at.


<a id="nestedatt--recommended"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recommended`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) CPU as a Kubernetes quantity (`250m`), as `runr_project.resources.cpu` takes it.
- `cpu_m` (Number) CPU in millicores.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MiB (`runr_project.resources.memory_mb`).


<a id="nestedatt--savings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `savings`

Read-Only:

- `basis` (String) `reserved` (always-on, pay as you go), `usage` (scale to zero: 0) or `fixed`.
- `currency` (String) Currency.
- `monthly` (Number) Monthly amount.
